current.text: He is likely an energy player off the bench for about 18 minutes, behind Maxime Raynaud.
He is not in the Kings' projected starting five. Sabonis is the projected starting center.
The Kings may trade Sabonis, which would change the frontcourt depth chart.

durable.text: Coach Ham describes him as a defensive-minded energy player.
He is a rebounds and blocks big. Blocks are his best category.
He is a poor free throw shooter. He shot 40% from the line in Summer League.
He makes no threes and scores very little, so threes and points are clear weak categories.
